summary: The `docs` and `chat` alias commands rewrite their Examples to the alias path (`clickup-pp-cli chat list <id>`) instead of keeping the spec-derived `workspaces chat` prefix with the alias verb.
reason: renameForAlias swapped only the verb, so every alias Example read like `clickup-pp-cli workspaces chat list <id>`, a path that does not exist. Help output showed users a command that fails, and live dogfood marked all 27 alias commands as having no runnable example.
validated_outcome: TestAliasExamplesUseAliasPath fails on all 27 alias commands without the rewrite and passes with it.
